item.ptxt: If alignment adjustment or removal/installation or replacement of suspension or chassis parts has been performed, after the work, set the front tires in the straight-ahead position, disconnect the battery terminal for 2 seconds or more, and then perform the settings required after disconnecting and reconnecting the battery terminal.

On vehicles with VSC, for the system to function normally, if alignment adjustment or removal/installation or replacement of suspension or chassis parts has been performed, always disconnect the battery terminal for 2 seconds or more to initialize the steering angle sensor, and after reconnecting, perform yaw rate sensor 0-point acquisition and the test mode inspection.

s2.ptxt: Inspect the side slip using a side slip tester.

item.ptxt: Drive onto the side slip tester in a straight line at walking speed (approximately 4km/h) or less, with the transmission in neutral.
Do not apply the brakes on the side slip tester.
Do not turn the steering wheel on the side slip tester.

s2.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, inspect the wheel alignment.
Bounce the vehicle to stabilize the suspension.
Push the vehicle forward 5m in a straight line by hand.

atten3.ptxt: If the vehicle is moved backward, always move it forward by the same distance it was moved backward.

s2.ptxt: Align the pointer height of the toe-in gauge with the height of the rear wheel axle center, and place it behind the tires.
Put tread center marks on the rear of the left and right rear tires, and measure the distance between the marks (B measurement).
Slowly push the vehicle forward to rotate the rear wheels 180°.

atten3.ptxt: Do not rotate the tires more than 180°. If the tires are rotated too far, start over from setting the toe-in gauge.

s2.ptxt: Measure the distance between the tread center marks on the front of the rear tires (A measurement).
Calculate the toe-in.
Inspect Rear Suspension Arm Assembly No.1

s3.ptxt: Inspect the nuts and adjusting tube visually and by hand. *1
Place matchmarks on the arm, nuts and adjusting tube as shown in the illustration. *2
Using SST, apply rotational torque to the adjusting tube in the extending and retracting directions, and check that the matchmark lines do not shift. *3

specitem.ptxt: T' = 16N*m{158kgf*cm} (reading when using SST and QL50N)

s3.ptxt: While holding the adjusting tube, using SST, apply rotational torque to the ball joint side nut in the loosening and tightening directions, and check that the matchmark lines do not shift. *4

specitem.ptxt: T' = 16N*m{158kgf*cm} (reading when using SST and QL50N)

s3.ptxt: If looseness of the adjusting tube or nuts is found in steps *1 to *4, replace rear suspension arm assembly No.1.

s2.ptxt: Measure the lengths of the left and right rear suspension arm assemblies No.1.

specitem.ptxt: Difference between left and right: 1mm or less

s2.ptxt: Loosen the 2 lock nuts of the adjusting tube.

atten3.ptxt: If a nut is abnormally tight when loosening it (90N*m{918kgf*cm} or more), or if the nut does not turn smoothly by hand after loosening, replace rear suspension arm assembly No.1.

s2.ptxt: If the difference in length between the left and right rear suspension arm assemblies No.1 is not within the standard, adjust it to within the standard using the following method.

s3.ptxt: If the toe-in is out of the standard toward the toe-in side, turn the adjusting tube of the shorter suspension arm assembly No.1 in the direction that lengthens the arm to adjust the left-right difference to within the standard.

If the toe-in is out of the standard toward the toe-out side, turn the adjusting tube of the longer suspension arm assembly No.1 in the direction that shortens the arm to adjust the left-right difference to within the standard.

s2.ptxt: Turn the left and right adjusting tubes by equal amounts in the same direction to adjust the toe-in.

item.ptxt: Turning the adjusting tube of rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH 1 turn in direction A in the illustration changes the toe by approximately 10mm toward toe-in.
Turning the adjusting tube of rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH 1 turn in direction B in the illustration changes the toe by approximately 10mm toward toe-out.

s2.ptxt: Attach a string and weight to the vehicle as shown in the illustration.
With the vehicle level, check the vertical direction using the string and weight.
Securely hold the adjusting tube and, using SST, temporarily tighten the ball joint side nut. *5

specitem.ptxt: T' = 16N*m{158kgf*cm} (reading when using SST and QL50N)

s2.ptxt: Turn the adjusting tube as shown in the illustration to adjust so that the ball joint socket is parallel to the string. *6
Securely hold the adjusting tube and, using SST, loosen the ball joint side nut. *7
Securely hold the adjusting tube and, using SST, fully tighten the nuts in the order: rubber bushing side → ball joint side → rubber bushing side. *8

specitem.ptxt: T' = 47N*m{475kgf*cm} (reading when using SST and QL100N)

s2.ptxt: Securely hold the adjusting tube again and, using SST, retighten the nuts in the order: rubber bushing side → ball joint side → rubber bushing side. (Final check) *9

specitem.ptxt: T' = 38N*m{382kgf*cm} (reading when using SST and QL100N)

s2.ptxt: Check that the ball joint socket is parallel to the string.

atten3.ptxt: If the ball joint socket is misaligned by 5° or more, perform steps *5 to *9 again.
